tools.Name: Scientific Agent Skills
tools.Description: A collection of 163 validated scientific skills, databases, and optimized workflows for AI agents.
tools.Use_Case: Automating complex research workflows in biology, chemistry, and drug discovery by providing curated tools for agents like Cursor or Claude Code.

tools.Name: OpenMontage
tools.Description: An agentic video production system that manages research, scripting, asset generation, editing, and final composition.
tools.Use_Case: Turning text prompts or reference videos into full-scale cinematic documentary or animated video productions using AI.

tools.Name: Graphify
tools.Description: A tool that converts codebases, documentation, and technical files into a queryable knowledge graph using AST parsing.
tools.Use_Case: Querying codebase architecture and relationships semantically rather than using regex-based grepping.
